Did Trump just kill Generative AI? 🤔


Steve Strickland (@SteveStricklan6)

Taken at face value, the Trump admin. ban on Fable calls into question the entire AI industry. The underlying technology is non-deterministic and therefore inherently unpredictable. It’s impossible to build in safeguards to reliably prevent jailbreaks. 

This is a turning point.
